execution: Approved escalated environment; source and test files remained frozen after the run.

contract.admission: Complete validateProjectPhysics2DObservation admission; invalid observation or missing exact sequence returns null.
contract.raw: Independent deeply frozen complete admitted selected sample and assemblyId; no author geometry or host authority.
contract.points: before [0,0]; requestedMotion and displacement endpoints relative to before; independent native contact positions relative to before; normalized unit normals.
contract.scale: All positions use one binary scale 2^projection.scaleExponent and stay finite in [-1,1]. Consumers use projected points directly. Fixed bounds [-1.25,1.25] on both axes.
contract.degradation: A genuine nonzero coordinate projected to zero by an extreme scale ratio sets projection.degraded; raw sample values remain unchanged.
exclusions: No inferred continuous path or contact-point trajectory

coverage: Exact selected row, complete identity/raw precision, deep freezing and independence from caller mutation
Requested and actual endpoints share before origin while positionAfter stays available separately
At most four independent contact points and normalized normals; original travel/remainder and raw normals retained
Zero and subnormal-only motion including Number.MIN_VALUE without an arbitrary scale floor
Huge absolute positions with small requests without absolute endpoint addition
Overflow-safe contact subtraction and explicit underflow degradation
Finite MAX_VALUE vectors and power-of-two rounding boundaries without clipping
One hundred deterministic extreme-range coordinate combinations, preserving admitted raw samples
Malformed or missing sequence rejection without fallback
Full observation validation including malformed unselected rows and source identities
No getter/serializer execution; custom prototypes, sparse arrays, cycles, symbols and hidden properties rejected
